rejected_program.code:
def solve(inputs, readings):
    entries = inputs["entries"]
    labels = readings["severity"]

    low = labels.count("low")
    medium = labels.count("medium")
    high = labels.count("high")

    high_times = [entries[i]["time"] for i, label in enumerate(labels) if label == "high"]

    def minutes(time):
        hour, minute = map(int, time.split(":"))
        return hour * 60 + minute

    medium_times = [minutes(entries[i]["time"]) for i, label in enumerate(labels) if label == "medium"]
    clustered = any(medium_times[i + 2] - medium_times[i] <= 60 for i in range(len(medium_times) - 2))
    escalate = bool(high_times) or clustered
    first_high = high_times[0] if high_times else "none"

    return f"{high} high, {medium} medium, {low} low | escalate {'yes' if escalate else 'no'} | first high {first_high}"

import math

def solve(inputs, readings):
    responses = inputs["responses"]
    sentiments = readings["sentiment"]
    total = len(responses)
    promoters = sum(1 for response in responses if response["rating"] >= 9)
    detractors = sum(1 for response in responses if response["rating"] <= 6)
    positive = sum(1 for sentiment in sentiments if sentiment == "positive")
    negative = sum(1 for sentiment in sentiments if sentiment == "negative")
    mismatches = sum(1 for response, sentiment in zip(responses, sentiments) if (response["rating"] >= 9 and sentiment == "negative") or (response["rating"] <= 6 and sentiment == "positive"))
    nps = math.floor(100 * (promoters - detractors) / total + 0.5) if total else 0
    return f"nps {nps} | {positive} positive, {negative} negative | {mismatches} mismatches"

program.code:
def solve(inputs, readings):
    applicants = inputs["applicants"]
    role = inputs["role"]
    roles = readings["applicant_roles"]

    shortlist = [
        (applicant["years"], applicant["name"])
        for applicant, applicant_role in zip(applicants, roles)
        if applicant_role == role and applicant["years"] >= 3
    ]
    shortlist.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
    names = ", ".join(name for years, name in shortlist) or "none"
    other_roles = sum(1 for applicant_role in roles if applicant_role != role)
    return f"{role}: shortlist {names} | {other_roles} other roles"
